definitions.short: emptiness ; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain
definitions.usage: empty, to no purpose, (in) vain (thing), vanity.
definitions.full: H7385. riyq רִיק noun [masculine] emptiness, vanity ; — chiefly in adverb phrase לְרִיק Isa 46:4 ; Job 39:16 in vain (of labour without benefit), so ׳לָר Lev 26:16 , 20 (H), Isa 65:23 ; and as adverb accusative רִיק 30:7 ; Psa 73:13 , probably also 2:1 (most = empty scheme as רֵיק 2 ) compare 4:3 (read probably רֵיק ); דִיק בְּדֵי Jer 51:58 = Hab 2:13 . — Jer 51:34 see רֵיק 1 above
